context.why: Stories 1 to 5 are accepted: levels decide access everywhere, Crediting (fairdm/contrib/contributors/services/crediting.py) is the one place a record's contributors change and it locks the record's row first, and the tab's pages are rebuilt over it. One page is still untested prototype code: ContributionMove in plugins/shared.py, which reorders in the view. The tab shows a record's people and its organizations as two lists, each in its own order, with move-earlier and move-later controls for someone who can manage the record. This story moves reordering into Crediting, gives the contribution queryset the two narrowing helpers, and makes the record's overview and citation follow the same order: people first, then organizations. It also closes a gap an earlier story found in the overview: a person credited with no organization must be shown with none.
spec_sections: FR-024 (a person credited with no organization is shown with none)
Clarifications ('Where a record names people and organizations together...')
Assumptions (who appears in a citation stays as specification 018 has it; this feature decides only the order)
prior_decisions: Contribution is an OrderedModel with one `order` column and no order_with_respect_to, so its own up()/down() would swap with a row on another record: do not use them. Crediting.move(contribution, direction) swaps the `order` values of the contribution and its neighbour of the same kind (person or organization) on the same record, inside the same lock-then-change path story 5 built for add, update and remove (reuse it, and add `move` to TestRecordLock's parametrisation in tests/test_contrib/test_contributors/test_services/test_crediting.py if that test is parametrised over the methods). Moving the first earlier or the last later changes nothing and raises nothing. If two contributions on a record share an order value (old data), move must still produce a deterministic result: order by (order, pk).

ContributionQuerySet (fairdm/contrib/contributors/managers.py) gains people() and organizations(): the contributions whose contributor is a Person, or an Organization, ordered by order then pk. Contributor is polymorphic (polymorphic_ctype); filter without loading every contributor. Use them in Crediting, in the tab's list and in RecordOverviewPlugin.

A new person is placed last among the people and a new organization last among the organizations (FR-059). Crediting.add already places a contributor last overall; confirm that gives last-within-kind and test it. Removing or editing a contributor leaves the others' order alone.

ContributionMove (the page) becomes a thin POST over Crediting.move: a visitor is sent to sign in, someone who cannot manage is refused with nothing changed, and a manager's POST redirects back to the tab at the moved contributor's anchor as it does now. The page takes `direction` = `up` or `down` from the form the approved templates already post (cotton/contribution/controls.html and cotton/contribution/organization.html); keep those field names and the templates unchanged.

RecordOverviewPlugin.get_contributions() (fairdm/core/plugins.py) returns people first, in order, then organizations, in order. Everything the four overviews and the dataset and project citations name comes from it, so they follow (FR-058). Do not change which contributors a citation names or how it is formatted: only the order. Test it where the overview and citation are tested today (tests/test_core/...), with a record whose people and organizations have been reordered.

RecordOverviewPlugin.get_credits() still falls back to the person's primary affiliation when a credit names no organization. Remove the fallback: a person credited with no organization gets none (FR-024, decisions.md D6). A pre-existing overview test that asserts the fallback describes behaviour this feature replaces: update it in T028 and name it in progress.md.
decisions.md D12: page tests of the tab go in tests/test_contrib/test_contributors/test_plugins/test_shared.py.

Docs (T029): ordering in the user guide page (docs/user-guide/crediting-a-record.md), including that people come before organizations where both are named; Crediting.move, people(), organizations() and the ContributionMove page in docs/portal-development/contributors.md. After this story the docs step should report only ContributorSeed, which story 7 owns.

acceptance.given_when_then: Given a record with several people and several organizations, when Crediting moves one, then it changes place only among its own kind, the ends do not move, a new contributor is last among its kind, and removing or editing one leaves the rest in place.

Given a manager, a reader and a visitor, when the move page is posted to, then the manager's move is saved and redirects to the tab and the others change nothing; and given a reordered record, the overview and the citation name people in the people's order with organizations after them, and a person credited with no organization is shown with none.
Given the failing tests from T026 and T027, when the implementation lands, then all pass and the page no longer reorders in the view.
Given the user guide and developer pages, when read against the branch, then they describe ordering and the names this story makes public, and the docs step reports only ContributorSeed.
